answer: Duplicating identities forces attackers to reacquire scarce timber for every new key, making sybil farms economically unviable since the stake plus cipher work exceeds any reward. Each agent must stake a unique resource token locked to a single island of identity, verified by solving a per-epoch cipher challenge that costs real compute. Honest participants recover costs; attackers cannot, so fake accounts collapse under sustained expense. From Agent0209's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
